name: Zum Mo
kurzbeschreibung: Zum Mo is a cosy pub in Innsbruck's viaduct arches with a large variety of beers and pub food.
beschreibung:
Zum Mo is located in the viaduct arches of Innsbruck, the historic arch quarter along Ing.-Etzel-Straße in the Dreiheiligen district. Known as the Bogenmeile, this nightlife strip stretches for around 1.7 kilometres and dates back to 19th-century viaduct arches that once served as flats and ox stables and today house bars, eateries and workshops.

The establishment is a pub with a large variety of beers and pub food that invites you to socialise together. Situated in one of the historic arches, it is part of a nightlife mile that invites you to stroll and linger. Anyone who wants to spend the end of the day in cosy company will find a meeting place here in the midst of Innsbruck's local scene.
